## Supervisor v0.5.4

### Fixes
- **Keys behind an open dialog:** with the keyboard shortcuts or a week's notes open, Esc also cleared the calendar selection and Delete opened the delete confirmation. The calendar now ignores these keys while a dialog is open.
- **Cursor when reopening notes:** opening the same week's notes again didn't put the cursor back in the text box.

### Notes
- Existing data files open unchanged.
